title: Built Around How You Organize Your Farm
description: Sized and priced for small and mid-sized row crop farms. Get organized records without a dedicated data team or another job on top of farming.

cards.title: Audit-Ready Reporting
cards.description: Use dated field records and templates to prepare an audit-ready report. Review and confirm it before your certification review.

cards.title: Farmer-Native Organization
cards.description: Keep records by farm, field, plot, and subplot, using your own names and boundaries. Build around how you already organize your land.

cards.title: Trustworthy AI, Not Blind AI
cards.description: AI helps structure voice notes and photos. Review and confirm the details before saving; you remain the final word on your farm records.

cards.title: Less Time on Paperwork
cards.description: Find timestamped records, receipts, and field notes in one place instead of retyping logs or rebuilding the story before a review.
